name: itixo
description: Itixo library for Copilot CLI users: agents, skills, rules and prompts shared across the company. Includes orchestration module (orchestrator on user-selected model delegates precise steps to cheaper-model subagents). Recommended companions: the caveman marketplace (https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman) and Mattpocock Skills (https://github.com/mattpocock/skills).
